from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from functools import partial
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys
import time
from blake3 import blake3
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from bench.crypto_hash import Workload, _measure

def load(path, prefix):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(prefix+'._stream_native',path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.absorb

def run(absorb, chunks):
    h=blake3()
    absorb(h,chunks)
    return h.digest()

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--baseline',required=True,type=Path)
p.add_argument('--output',required=True,type=Path)
a=p.parse_args()
before=load(next(a.baseline.glob('_stream_native*.so')),'_saved_stream')
after=load(next(Path('src/unstd/crypto').glob('_stream_native*.so')),'_current_stream')
chunks={}
for container in (tuple,list):
    for count,width in ((8,1),(8,64),(8,1023),(8,2048),(31,2048),(32,2048),(33,2048),(4096,1),(8192,1),(4096,64),(4096,1023),(4096,2048),(8,4096),(8,131072),(8192,0)):
        block=(bytes(range(251))*(width//251+1))[:width]
        chunks[f'{container.__name__}/{count}x{width}']=container([block]*count)
    chunks[f'{container.__name__}/mixed']=container([b'a'*1023]*17+[bytearray(b'mutable')]+[b'b'*64]*9+[b'c'*4096]*8+[b'd']*9)
results={}
for i,(name,parts) in enumerate(chunks.items()):
    case=Workload(name,sum(map(len,parts)),partial(run,before,parts),partial(run,after,parts))
    row=_measure(case,13,.035,i)
    results[name]=row
    print(f'{name:27s} {row["median_paired_speedup"]:.3f}x {row["median_ns"]["before"]:.0f}->{row["median_ns"]["after"]:.0f} ns {"noisy" if row["noisy"] else ""}',flush=True)
a.output.write_text(json.dumps({'environment':{'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'load_average':os.getloadavg()},'cases':results},indent=2)+'\n')

from __future__ import annotations
from functools import partial
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from bench.crypto_hash import _calibrate
from blake3 import blake3

def load(path, namespace):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(namespace+'._stream_native',path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.absorb

def run(absorb, chunks):
    h=blake3()
    absorb(h,chunks)
    return h.digest()

def batch(call,n):
    cpu=time.process_time_ns()
    wall=time.perf_counter_ns()
    for _ in range(n): call()
    return {'iterations':n,'wall_per_op_ns':(time.perf_counter_ns()-wall)/n,'cpu_per_op_ns':(time.process_time_ns()-cpu)/n}

def measure(calls,index):
    assert calls[0]()==calls[1]()
    n=[_calibrate(c,35000000) for c in calls]
    samples=[[],[]]
    for r in range(19):
        for side in ([0,1] if (r+index)%2==0 else [1,0]):
            samples[side].append(batch(calls[side],n[side]))
    ratio=[a['wall_per_op_ns']/b['wall_per_op_ns'] for a,b in zip(*samples)]
    rng=random.Random(0)
    bootstrap=sorted(statistics.median(rng.choices(ratio,k=len(ratio))) for _ in range(5000))
    spread=[max(row['wall_per_op_ns'] for row in rows)/min(row['wall_per_op_ns'] for row in rows)-1 for rows in samples]
    return {'samples':samples,'median_paired_speedup':statistics.median(ratio),'median_cpu_speedup':statistics.median(a['cpu_per_op_ns']/b['cpu_per_op_ns'] for a,b in zip(*samples)),'bootstrap_median_95ci':[bootstrap[125],bootstrap[4875]],'spread':spread,'noisy':any(s>.25 for s in spread)}

before=load(next(Path('/tmp/unstd-hash-baseline-IKNVYw/crypto').glob('_stream_native*.so')),'_saved_stream_controls')
after=load(next(Path('src/unstd/crypto').glob('_stream_native*.so')),'_current_stream_controls')
tiny=[b'x']*8
bulk=[b'x'*1023]*4096
cases={'tiny-baseline-self':(partial(run,before,tiny),partial(run,before,tiny)),'tiny-candidate-self':(partial(run,after,tiny),partial(run,after,tiny)),'tiny-A-B':(partial(run,before,tiny),partial(run,after,tiny)),'bulk-baseline-self':(partial(run,before,bulk),partial(run,before,bulk)),'bulk-candidate-self':(partial(run,after,bulk),partial(run,after,bulk)),'bulk-A-B':(partial(run,before,bulk),partial(run,after,bulk))}
results={}
for i,(name,calls) in enumerate(cases.items()):
    row=measure(calls,i)
    results[name]=row
    print(name,row['median_paired_speedup'],row['median_cpu_speedup'],row['bootstrap_median_95ci'],row['noisy'],flush=True)
Path('/tmp/unstd-stream-copy-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps({'environment':{'python':sys.version,'load_average':os.getloadavg()},'cases':results},indent=2)+'\n')
methodology: 32 alternating paired workloads, 13 rounds at35ms/batch; follow-up 6 CPU/wall self-control and comparison workloads,19 rounds at35ms/batch. Noise=sample spread>25%. BootstrapCI descriptive paired-median resampling,5000samples seed0; not an all-platform no-regression guarantee.
